verdict.rationale: Temporal documents three message types (Signals, Queries, Updates) and describes Workflows as stateful services with message handlers, "akin to endpoints." The Temporal Client explicitly supports signaling a specific Workflow Execution from outside, which fits waiting on human approval (temporal-docs-41). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of signaling from another workflow or wiring a webhook to a signal, and independent hands-on corroboration of signal delivery.
